hypotheses.observation: Inspect HTML/SSR for brand categories and product lists.
hypotheses.test: Search SSR DOM for anchors and titles matching brand.
hypotheses.result: Page title is 'Nicopoly | Paris.cl'. 181 brand-related or brand-store links exist in the global navigation, but DOM is dominated by the site-wide Mega Menu.

hypotheses.observation: Inspect structured data / JSON-LD for category taxonomy.
hypotheses.result: Two JSON-LD blocks present (WebPage and ItemList), providing base canonical URLs but no category facet hierarchy.

hypotheses.observation: Inspect hydration and embedded state in Paris page.
hypotheses.test: Analyze Next.js App Router streaming chunks (self.__next_f.push) in HTML.
hypotheses.result: Paris uses Next.js App Router streaming RSC instead of __NEXT_DATA__. In chunk 280, Paris embeds the official brand store route ('/mujer/marcas/nicopoly/'), and in chunk 285 embeds generalFacets ('tipoProductoAll') with product categories (Abrigos: 24, Blusas: 61, etc.).

hypotheses.observation: Inspect links and navigation anchors in DOM.
hypotheses.result: DOM contains over 2000 links due to the uncollapsed site-wide Mega Menu in <details> tags. category_discoverer.py picked '/outlet/outlet-electro/outlet-televisores/' from the mega-menu and appended '?q=nicopoly', mistakenly attempting it as a Nicopoly category.

hypotheses.observation: Inspect filters and facets on Paris search results.
hypotheses.test: Check filter buttons and facet containers.
hypotheses.result: Filter buttons are present on PLP, but ParisScraper does not implement apply_brand_facet, discover_navigation_source, or discover_navigation.

hypotheses.observation: Inspect network requests emitted by search page.
hypotheses.result: 93 requests captured including internal Next.js RSC fetches (?_rsc=...), but no standalone category tree JSON endpoint like Ripley's.

hypotheses.observation: Inspect URL transition to brand catalog or category facet.
hypotheses.test: Navigate to official brand catalog /mujer/marcas/nicopoly/ or faceted search URL.
hypotheses.result: The canonical brand hub URL in Paris is /search?q=nicopoly (539 products) or /mujer/marcas/nicopoly/. Subcategories require parsing tipoProductoAll facets from RSC or facet query parameters (?tipoProductoAll=...).

root_cause_analysis.observed: MRI-4MARKETPLACES-BASELINE-001 reported Paris BRAND_DISCOVERY = FAIL after scraping 539 products on Brand Hub (search?q=nicopoly) and then attempting category 'Outlet Televisores' (5 TVs, 0 Nicopoly products).
root_cause_analysis.hypothesis: BRAND_DISCOVERY failed because: (1) baseline_4mp.py checked for 'brand_evidence_count_text' which was never emitted; (2) category_discoverer.py looks for __NEXT_DATA__ which does not exist on Paris (Next.js App Router RSC streaming), falling back to extracting anchors from the global site-wide Mega-Menu, resulting in spurious cross-departmental noise ('Outlet Televisores'); (3) ParisScraper lacks discover_navigation and apply_brand_facet adapters.
root_cause_analysis.test: Executed PA1-PA7 forensics, parsed self.__next_f streaming chunks, and inspected DOM anchor distribution and baseline event logs.
root_cause_analysis.result: Confirmed. Paris uses Next.js App Router RSC streaming where genuine category facets ('tipoProductoAll') and official brand URL ('/mujer/marcas/nicopoly/') reside in self.__next_f, while DOM anchor scanning erroneously ingested the global Mega-Menu.
root_cause_analysis.next_smallest_fix: Add Next.js App Router streaming RSC parser to category_discoverer.py to extract 'tipoProductoAll' facets and brand store URLs, isolate/ignore the global Mega-Menu (<details class='group/details'>), and fix the event emission key in autonomous_pipeline.py.
